name: Rufford Small Grants
summary: Staged grants for early-career conservationists running nature conservation projects on threatened species in emerging and developing economies, from a first grant up to booster and completion grants.

eligibility.rule: Project has a nature conservation focus
Any species the project works on is threatened
Applicant is not studying for a BSc or equivalent
No pure research, expeditions, conferences, seminars or book publishing
Funds are paid to an organisation, not a personal account
Applicants from advanced economies: project in an eligible country, high priority, builds local capacity

documents: Evidence of support from co-funders, if applicable

status.quote: There are no deadlines - applications can be submitted at any time of year.

applicant_types.quote: You should be in the early stages of your conservation career.

geography.quote: The Rufford Foundation funds nature conservation projects in emerging or developing economy countries.

access.quote: Here you can apply for a grant online

window.quote: There are no deadlines - applications can be submitted at any time of year.

effort.quote: All applications are reviewed initially by The Rufford Foundation office.
Those considered for further processing pass to the second stage, review by external experts.

eligibility.quote: Projects must have a nature conservation focus.
Any species you are working on must be considered threatened.
No, the Foundation will not fund projects that have already begun.
However, we do not fund students studying for a BSc or equivalent.
We will only consider fieldwork costs.
Pure research with no obvious conservation benefit. Expeditions, particularly where the applicant must raise funds in order to participate. Attending conferences or seminars. Publishing books.
Funds are ONLY paid to organisations (such as a nature conservation NGO or university department).

We will not consider projects from applicants from advanced economies unless the project is in an eligible country, of high conservation priority and efforts are made to enhance local conservation capacity.

after_award.quote: You must provide project updates and a final report on project completion, copies of which will be posted on your webpage.

documents.quote: You need to provide three references to accompany your application.
We will require evidence of support from co-funders.
